name: Surface
description: Themed container atom providing the default background, radius, and padding for slotted content. Because every color is a semantic token, the surface re-themes automatically under a dark variable mode.

props.name: border
props.description: Show the 1px subtle border around the surface (Figma variant default: true).

props.name: content
props.description: Slotted content rendered inside the surface (Figma .content SLOT).

notes: Purely presentational container — no implicit role. Landmark/heading semantics belong to the slotted content.
Token-bound background/content pairings keep text contrast AA in both light and dark modes.
